problem_understanding: Need to buy enough pencils with one package type.

steps.claim: For a package with count c, floor(n / c) packages are enough.
Use floor division for all three package types and take the minimum cost.
steps.justification: The smallest cost should be optimal.
Only three package types are checked.

algorithm: Use n / count for each package type and take the minimum.
correctness_argument: This is invalid when n is not divisible by count.
final_output_or_verdict: May output too small a cost on non-exact division cases.
